summary:
Frontend-only testing of 5 UI/UX refinements: currency consistency (₹ vs Rs/$), Daily Updates global Leads/Invoicing tabs, Project header Excel+PDF buttons for all statuses, Inventory active dot + QC Checklist, and Notification bell. All 5 features verified working end-to-end via Playwright. Minor: 4 stray 'Rs' literals in form labels and a React hydration warning in InventoryManagement (Badge nested inside

).

passed_tests: Notification count badge shows 11 (matches GET /api/alerts/dashboard total_alerts)
Clicking bell opens notification-panel listing 'Profit Leakage Alerts · 11 active · Impact ₹1,62,907' with risky project entries
Daily Updates page shows ALL 7 tabs in order: Leads Update (Global), Invoicing (Global), Project Progress, Material Usage, Payment, Installation, O&M
Leads tab: project selector HIDDEN, leads-total field visible; saving POSTs /api/daily-updates with project_id='general' -> 200 (id returned)
Invoicing tab: project selector HIDDEN, inv-count field visible
Project Progress tab: project selector reappears (visual confirmation in screenshot)
Inventory: 18 status dots rendered across desktop+mobile (data-testid=status-dot-{id} / status-dot-mobile-{id}); 8/9 green active, 1 grey inactive (Test Inverter 5kW)
Inventory dialog: Active toggle visible (data-testid=item-active-toggle) and 'QC Checklist' section text present
QC badges 'QC: 3' visible on 2 items in list confirming qc_checklist persistence
Project Details for draft project: Excel + PDF buttons BOTH visible (data-testid=download-excel-btn / download-pdf-btn)
Currency check: /dashboard/credits has ₹ symbol, /dashboard/ceo has ₹ symbol, /dashboard/reports — no stray 'Rs' literals on body text
No DollarSign icon usage anywhere in /app/frontend/src
No uncaught JS exceptions during any flow (only 401 resource warning + hydration warning)
